title: stalkya muscicola
intro: Stalkya muscicola, commonly known as African starfish, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, contributing to the management of conditions like fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Stalkya muscicola include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and display anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
